Director of People
Quarry Software - Denver, CO

Quarry Software sells scheduling tools to 3,000 construction firms. Our next Director of People
builds the team from 180 to 300 and owns how we hire, pay and grow.

Requirements
- 8+ years of HR experience, 3+ in a leadership role
- Own the people budget as part of the company P&L
- Partner with finance on revenue and headcount planning

Preferred
- Equity compensation and stock option plans
- Running workplace investigations

Hybrid in Denver. Stock options, health cover and a home office budget.
